notes.title: Discover the Discounted Conan Bundle!
notes.content:
Greetings Everyone, 

90 years ago, in December 1932, [i]The Phoenix on the Sword[/i] appeared in Weird Tales. This was the first Conan the Barbarian short story to be published by Robert E. Howard. Since then, the world of Conan and the legend of his adventures has only continued to grow.  

[h3][b]Exiled, Unconquered, and... Chop Chop! [/b][/h3]

Today, we celebrate this anniversary by highlighting the rich videogame legacy of Conan through The Conan Bundle, which includes Conan Exiles, Conan Unconquered, and Conan Chop Chop: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25298994/6201f17cf585be9d77634db6162d47310e53b001.jpg[/img]

[b]Conan Exiles[/b] – Survive, build, and conquer in a vast savage land. 
The online multiplayer survival game, now with sorcery, set in the lands of Conan the Barbarian. Survive and explore a vast open world sandbox, build your home into a kingdom, and dominate your enemies in single or multiplayer. 

[b]Conan Unconquered[/b] – Defy the wrath of endless hordes with strategy and strength. 
From the Command & Conquer veterans at Petroglyph comes the first ever survival RTS set in the savage world of Conan the Barbarian. Stand against the innumerable hordes with the strength of your army, heroes like Conan, and in a last resort, the colossal Avatar of Mitra himself. Defend your stronghold solo or together in co-op. 

[b]Conan Chop Chop[/b] – Thrive and die gloriously in frantically funny top-down battle. 
Charge into a party roguelite for 1-4 players full of mayhem, loot, and adventure. In this outrageous take on Conan the Barbarian, you are the muscle-bound hero foolish enough to try and stop the evil wizard Thoth-Amon! 

[b]With both the Winter Sale (50-60%) and additional Bundle Discount (10%), this is a fantastic opportunity to explore these three games.[/b] If you already own any of them, buying the bundle will simply add what you are missing. Please note that The Conan Bundle includes the base games, not expansions and DLC content. 

The anniversary and Conan Bundle aren’t the only reasons to celebrate. Released this month, you can pick up the first Conan novel in over a decade – [url=https://titanbooks.com/71123-conan-blood-of-the-serpent/]Conan – Blood of the Serpent[/url], by S.M. Stirling. 

It’s time to raise your sword and plunge into the savage world of sword and sorcery, myth and monsters. 

From the whole team here at Funcom, we wish you an amazing holiday! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25298994/3ae84e00ee0a375bc299cf0f3249ad74789c2edf.png[/img]

notes.title: Conan Chop Chop March Update
notes.content:
[i]We’ve just put out an update with a number of fixes and improvements. A big 
thanks to all of you for the reports and feedback, which continue to be very 
valuable.[/i]
[h3]Skill Points Bug [/h3]
The team is hard at work on a final fix for an issue relating to their skill tree and 
points, which caused some players to receive too many skill points. As a result, they
would not receive any additional points the next time they leveled up. This should 
not happen anymore. 

However, players who have experienced this may continue to not receive skill 
points when leveling up. This will be resolved in our next patch, where we will reset 
the skill tree and reallocate all points depending on your level. We thank you for 
your patience in the meantime.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35215204/e45d7d087e1c868088f6ca47f31ef0d850d31eac.png[/img]

[*] Fixed an issue affecting game stability which caused players to become stuck in

infinite loading state

[*] Fixed an issue causing the tutorial to reset a player's active run

notes.title: Conan Chop Chop battles its way onto PC today, with publishers donating to Ukraine
notes.content:
Co-op roguelite Conan Chop Chop brings its barbarian action to Steam today. Die a lot, alone or with friends or strangers, on the couch or online. (Probably don't invite strangers to your house to play though). Then get stronger, improve your equipment, and hopefully die less until you can triumph over an evil wizard and prove once and for all that brawn is better than brains.

Read more

notes.title: Get to the Chop Chop! Out now!
notes.content:
Here we are, 1,065 days since we first teased it, several delays, a few Covid variants later and boom. Conan Chop Chop is out NOW! Easy peasy! 

[previewyoutube=wRghKxSi5h0;full][/previewyoutube]
  
We can’t wait to see what crazy charm combinations you come up with and what insane adventures you get up to. Thank you to all of you who have been waiting patiently all this time. And thanks to the rest who joined along the way. This is a weird direction for a character as beloved as Conan and your support has meant the world to us.

Grab a couple of friends and immerse yourselves in the absolute madness that is Conan Chop Chop. We hope you like it! 

[i]A special message regarding the situation in Ukraine: [/i]

Like most of the world, the horrible events taking place in Ukraine are at the forefront of our minds. We want to take this opportunity to bring awareness to the humanitarian crisis and do our small part to help. Funcom will be donating 100,000 USD of the proceeds from Conan Chop Chop to the humanitarian efforts in Ukraine through the Red Cross. 

Others can also donate to the relief efforts via the Ukraine crisis Red Cross website: 
https://www.icrc.org/en/donate/ukraine 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1061880/Conan_Chop_Chop/

notes.title: Conan Chop Chop is (finally) coming out on the 1st of March!
notes.content:
We first teased this game on April 1st, 2019. The joke there was that nobody would believe it was real while, in the background, we were very seriously working on this game. At E3 that year we took to the stage at the PC Gamer Show to announce that it was in fact coming out, and soon. We announced a release date of September 2019. The lesson to be learned there is do not mess with fate. If you try to mess with the power of April fools, it will turn around and make a fool out of you. 

[previewyoutube=WPqlgtzyULs;full][/previewyoutube]
  
The pandemic is certainly a factor in the delays. But the truth is, we knew we could make the game even better if we spent more time on it. And we're so happy we've given this game the time it has needed because it's become such a joy to play especially in co-op. So, without any further fake-outs or switch-a-roos, Conan Chop Chop is finally ready. We will be releasing a free Demo at the Steam Next Fest on the 21st of February, and after that we're releasing the full game on the 1st of April. Wait, no, bad idea. We’ll release it on the 1st of March! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35215204/2b9869fb37230b8776bcab0e97fbcb400fbb0bff.jpg[/img]

Conan Chop Chop is a party rogue-lite for 1-4 players full of mayhem, loot, and adventure. In this outrageous take on Conan the Barbarian, you are the muscle-bound hero foolish enough to try and stop the evil wizard Thoth-Amon!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35215204/92ae507b96e91ba3ffa47b44e5eb9afc8ca9b09d.jpg[/img]

Hyboria is waiting for those of you who have been so patient with us, and we hope you know we never took your support for granted. It was the warm reception received in 2019 that kept us moving forward in the hopes of making Chop Chop the game that it can be!

notes.title: Conan Chop Chop Release Moved to Q2 2020
notes.content:
With all the elements of a hack and slash rogue-lite for 1-4 players being packed into one game, it’s no wonder developer Mighty Kingdom and publisher Funcom have decided to move the launch of Conan Chop Chop from February 25th to Q2 2020.

We're almost at the finish line, but we need a little extra time to optimize the game for online multiplayer. This also gives us a chance to add extra polish to the game.

It's all about getting that final Chop in place. It's not a one-chop game, it's [i]Conan Chop Chop[/i], and we need that extra attention to detail.

notes.title: Conan Chop Chop will be out in February
notes.content:
Conan Chop Chop was 'announced' on April 1 as a joke, but was then revealed to be a real game at 2019's PC Gaming Show. A couple months later, it met the first and only criterion for being a real game: being delayed.

Now we have a final, final release date: Chibi Conan and pals will start chopping their way through ghouls on February 25, 2020. 

Chop Chop is described as a "roguelite" by publisher Funcom, and as a "party game" for up to four players, with both online and local co-op support. The Steam page has a few more details, but the premise is pretty clear: collect items and weapons, adventure across 2D maps, and chop everything that needs chopping. It's a familiar-looking game, coming off as something like Enter the Gungeon or Nuclear Throne but with swords, spears, and hammers instead of guns.

Whether or not it can match the brilliance of those games we'll find out next year. The flatness of the vector-style art doesn't do much for me, but the cleanliness of its colors and lines is perhaps part of the joke—it diverges as much as possible from what one expects from a Conan the Barbarian game.

I've embedded the new trailer above if you want to get a better sense of Conan Chop Chop's chopping.

notes.title: Conan Chop Chop, the April Fool's joke that became a real game, delayed to 2020
notes.content:
Funcom announced Conan Chop Chop on April 1, and in case you didn't notice the timing it was very clearly an April Fools joke. A couple of months later, the joke was on us when Funcom announced that it's actually a real game that would be out in September. But due to an expanded scope, it won't hit that mark.

Conan Chop Chop is a hack-and-slash action-roguelike with couch co-op support for up to four players, and that's apparently gone over very well with people who've got their hands on the pre-release demo. So now Funcom and developer Mighty Kingdom have decided to take it further with the addition of online multiplayer as well.

"We had an absolute blast showcasing the game at E3 and Gamescom earlier this year. It was especially gratifying to see how much fun people had playing the game in co-op mode. The teamwork, the banter, the way people moved ever so sneakily towards their near-death companions in order to pick up their gold when they fall. We couldn’t have been happier with the reception," Mighty Kingdom CEO Philip Mayes said.

"This has undoubtedly been THE most requested feature after we started showing off the game, so we’re very excited for the opportunity to bring that in."

Naturally, that's going to take a little extra time, and so Conan Chop Chop is now slated to come out sometime in the first quarter of 2020.

notes.title: Conan Chop Chop is real, and its brain spiders can get in the bin, then into a volcano
notes.content:
Conan Chop Chop is real. It’s a cutesy dungeon crawler with 1-4 player co-op. Mighty Kingdom made it, Funcom are publishing it. It’ll be out around September. Good. Fine. Good. Can we talk about these horrible leggy brain things in this picture I found please. What? Why? How do they even feed? Do they have telekinetic powers like the Brain Bugs in Starship Troopers? If so, why are they running into chop-chopping distance? Brains don’t do well against swords, that’s the whole point of skulls. Why are there legs coming out of their cerebellums? How can they fit the required neurological and muscular apparatus in there? Are those purple splats on the other side of the screen the remains of defeated brain bugs? Is that a CHUFFING WEB?

(more…)

notes.title: Conan Chop Chop is not an April Fools Joke! Comes to PC on September 3rd
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35215204/c89c01b82e922226cbd94c57562a7bbf61b71365.jpg[/img]

Today we are very happy to announce that what you thought was a joke is definitely a real game. On April 1st, Funcom announced Conan Chop Chop as an April Fools joke, but not only is the game real, it’s coming to PC, PS4, Xbox One and Nintendo Switch in less than 3 months! 

Grab a sword, grab a friend, and get ready to chop chop on September 3rd. 
 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=I8siCrehVDs 

Conan Chop Chop is a roguelike hack & slash game featuring colorful characters, wicked monsters, evil wizards, a diverse and vast world, and plenty of loot. Travel the lands of Hyboria alone, or with up to three friends, in a quest to save the world from Thoth-Amon and Xaltotun. 
 
Add the game to your wishlist so you don't forget about it at launch:  

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1061880
